translationRepairs: On renzi Ma Yin of Jingjiang and Guizhou—acting Grand Preceptor, Secretariat director, and Prince of Fufeng—gained fief and enfeoffment; Ma Xizhen of Li-Lang—acting Grand Tutor and Palace Attendant—became acting Grand Guardian.

On renzi Ma Cong of Jingjiang and Guizhou—acting Grand Preceptor, Secretariat director, and Prince of Fufeng—gained fief and enfeoffment; Ma Xizhen of Li-Lang—acting Grand Tutor and Palace Attendant—became acting Grand Guardian.
Chinese names 馬賨, not 馬殷; idiomatic Ma Yin misidentifies the Prince of Fufeng. The proposed Ma Cong matches 馬賨 and leaves the rest of the sentence intact.

On renzi, Jingjiang army military commissioner, Guizhou circuit surveillance commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, Prince of Fufeng Ma Yin gained added fief households and enfeoffment; Li-Lang surveillance commissioner, acting Grand Tutor, concurrent Palace Attendant Ma Xizhen was made acting Grand Guardian.

On renzi, Jingjiang army military commissioner, Guizhou circuit surveillance commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, Prince of Fufeng Ma Cong gained added fief households and enfeoffment; Li-Lang surveillance commissioner, acting Grand Tutor, concurrent Palace Attendant Ma Xizhen was made acting Grand Guardian.
Same error in the literal field: the name is 馬賨 (Ma Cong), not Ma Yin. Replacing only that name corrects the mistranslation without other changes.
Mingzong had served under Jianfeng in Taiyuan's inner guard; now Jianfeng lay crippled by stroke, so Mingzong visited to comfort him.
Mingzong had been a personal guard commander in Taiyuan's inner barracks with Jianfeng as his deputy; now Jianfeng lay crippled by stroke, so Mingzong visited to comfort him.

帝嘗為太原內牙親將，建豐為副 makes the Emperor the inner-barracks personal commander and Jianfeng his deputy; idiomatic "served under Jianfeng" reverses that hierarchy. The proposed wording restores the correct relationship.
On gengyin Li Yan of Guest Reception became Si defense commissioner and Li Ling of Heyang became crown prince mentor.
On gengyin Li Yan of Guest Reception became Si defense commissioner and Li Ling of Hezhong became crown prince mentor.
Chinese 河中 is Hezhong, not 河陽 (Heyang). Changing only that place-name corrects the idiomatic error.
